metadata.goal: Read a markdown file and produce a word frequency report listing the 20 most common words, excluding stopwords, written to output/ as a text file
metadata.platform_note: Tier 2 (Cursor/Windsurf/Cline): no agent files; all steps execute inline in the entry skill's session. dispatch_mechanism is inline. model is inherit — host IDE owns model selection. No Task() primitive. Reviewer isolation is convention-only.
degradation_warnings: Reviewer isolation impossible on this platform: writer and reviewer are the same agent in the same context. Review steps execute the reviewer protocol but cannot provide assumption-blindness defense or context-bleed isolation. Treat review output as a self-check, not verification.
Parallel fan-out (Pattern 2) requires worktrees and is unavailable on this platform (worktrees: false).
Model selection is owned by the host IDE; per-step model assignment is not emitted.

steps.description: Reads the input markdown file, tokenizes the text, counts word frequencies (excluding common English stopwords), writes frequency-counts.json to the temp directory. Executes inline in the entry skill's session.

Reads frequency-counts.json from the temp directory, selects the top-20 words by frequency, formats and writes the word frequency report to output/parity-test-g-word-freq.txt. Executes inline in the entry skill's session.
